name: Minimal line art (html-capture)
description: Black and white line art: hairline steps rise, a white dot hops up them and an orbit draws around it at the top, under one quiet lowercase line. Adapted from minimalistic-graphics (MIT).

cautions: Quiet and plain: lowercase captions, no emojis, no bold, no exclamation marks.
The picture is a dot climbing steps, so the idea should be about steady progress (habits, compounding, patience).
Captions are drawn by the page as one line at the top, lowercased.

provenance.licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Artem Novitckii (render/LICENSE); font Poppins from kit/fonts: SIL OFL 1.1 (render/fonts/OFL-poppins.txt)
provenance.notes: Adapted: the motif (outlined steps between x 137 and 853 rising from y 1240 to 520, the dot with squash and stretch, the masked orbit and ring, 22 sparks, the steps dimming), the timing formula (step = min(.5, max(.3, 1.6/(n-1))), payoff = .42 + step*(n-2) + .58, length = payoff + 1.6 s), the eases, colours and the Poppins line. Changed: the one line of text is the narration's caption (the page draws it, lowercased); a bar or counter series of 2 to 6 values sets the number and heights of the steps, otherwise the skill's 5 even steps; one motif per scene, played faster when the scene is shorter than its natural length; the light variant is not offered; GSAP replaced by a small frame-driven timeline (render/motion.js); the font embedded as a data: URL; HyperFrames not used. Not copied: the skill's example lines or any demo output.

provenance.ref: venturazz/venstudio docs/plans/style-system.md (Phase 3: Template Lab, first packs from claude-animation-skills)
